ChipK Design System Kickstart

This package captures the design-system extraction for ChipK from supplied color styles and Figma references.

Current Scope

  • Color, typography, spacing, shape, size, and state tokens.
  • Mobile dark trading/watchlist app shell.
  • Extracted components: top app bar, bottom navigation, realtime quote row, realtime quote tile, stock label, stock card, main force stock row, main force weather indicator, main force trade tag, portfolio preference header, portfolio fit chart, portfolio fit list header, portfolio fit stock row, portfolio attribute label, portfolio fit assessment indicator, portfolio stock sheet cell, portfolio fit stock sheet, portfolio fit detail table, similar stock button, portfolio preferred stock title, portfolio preferred stock top bar, portfolio preferred stock list header, portfolio preferred stock row, valuation label, quarter line status icon, portfolio health check cell, portfolio health check row, portfolio health report section, portfolio profit summary, bottom sheet, bottom sheet footer button, bottom sheet header, bottom sheet cell, switch, selection control, MyStock utility icon, New Badge, broker icon, promotional badge, broker import header, broker import row, broker import menu, portfolio add action button, portfolio add action section, portfolio add holding sheet, portfolio manual import value field, portfolio manual import cell, portfolio manual import row, market tab strip, market filter tab strip, relative date label, event name label, event table row, return today button, event filter dropdown, event filter option, event filter sheet, floating action pill, edge status toggle, popup dialog, global bubble, button, and empty state.

Key Decisions

  • Use strict ref -> sys -> comp token inheritance.
  • Preserve mobile-first dark trading-app density.
  • Preserve Taiwan market color semantics: red is up, green is down.
  • Keep portfolio analysis category colors separate from market movement colors.
  • Keep temporal date colors separate from market movement, warning/success, and portfolio category colors.
  • Keep event name orange separate from filled primary action semantics.
  • Keep event table rows compact, bordered, and data-led when stock identity and event details must be paired.
  • Keep return-today and event filter controls compact, outline-based, and 28px high.
  • Keep event filter category selection as a compact bottom sheet grid using filled options.
  • Keep portfolio preference headers compact and actionable.
  • Keep portfolio fit list headers and rows column-aligned with shared size tokens.
  • Keep portfolio fit sub-statuses compact and column-bound: 68x20 for fit assessment, 105x24 for attribute labels.
  • Keep fit-assessment match/mismatch semantics separate from market movement and generic success/error semantics, even when raw red/green values are reused.
  • Keep portfolio fit stock explanation as a compact 375x605 bottom sheet, not a full-screen profile or dashboard.
  • Keep portfolio fit detail tables fixed-column and right-align individual performance and score values.
  • Keep Portfolio Fit Detail Table header and row variants inside the existing table component; do not create a separate header-row or detail-row component for these nodes.
  • Keep Portfolio Fit Detail Table header at 36px and detail rows at 48px with fixed 171/100/64 columns.
  • Keep Portfolio Fit Detail Table info rows column-stable when the performance value is empty; preserve the empty 100px value column and the right score column.
  • Keep portfolio fit score color separate from market-up semantics even when the raw red value is reused.
  • Keep preferred-stock discovery table-led with a 38px title, 44px context top bar, 34px header, and 61px rows.
  • Keep preferred-stock list columns independent from the earlier portfolio fit list columns.
  • Keep valuation labels as valuation semantics, not market movement or portfolio category semantics.
  • Keep portfolio health-check rows diagnostic and horizontally table-led with fixed 659x61 composition.
  • Keep health-check stock identity as the only observed sticky-shadow cell.
  • Keep quarter-line status red/green semantics tied to the technical condition, not generic success/error.
  • Keep portfolio health report detail sections flat, 375px wide, and text/table led; do not convert valuation, quality, or exception details into cards or dashboard widgets.
  • Keep portfolio realtime profit/loss as one compact 375px module with a stable three-column summary and optional chart expansion.
  • Keep allocation chart colors separate from portfolio attribute category colors.
  • Keep secondary market filters compact and text-led: active state is orange label text on the same dark item fill.
  • Keep Realtime Quote Row as the owner of the enlarged 79px watchlist/event row; do not fork a separate quote-row component for the candlestick marker variant.
  • Keep main-force rows under the 主力籌碼 view as flat 375x61 rows with fixed weather/value/tag slots.
  • Keep Main Force Weather Indicator row-bound at 98px wide; do not convert it into a chart, card, or legend.
  • Keep Main Force Trade Tag separate from Portfolio Attribute Label, Promotional Badge, New Badge, and Event Name Label because size, semantics, and colors differ.
  • Keep main-force red buy signals separate from stock-up market values even when the raw red is reused.
  • Keep primary inventory tabs compact and separate from secondary market filters: active state is white label text on the same 37px dark strip, with chevron color only for 看盤/盤後.
  • Keep primary tab system size token names free of component words by using market-primary in sys layer and market-tab-strip only in component layer.
  • Reuse Floating Action Pill for side action sets; 設定, 編輯, and 下單 all keep the 68x30 icon-label pill contract.
  • Keep broker/source icons container-led and avoid inferring selection, connection, or disabled states from the default icon set.
  • Keep promotional badges compact and text-led; do not promote them to CTAs, warning chips, or large marketing tags.
  • Keep broker import flows row-led with 37-38px headers and 132px rows; compose rows from Broker Icon, Promotional Badge, and standalone Switch instead of creating card-style account panels.
  • Use standalone Switch for broker import switch slots; broker rows own label, icon, promo, helper copy, and placement.
  • Keep broker import 查看庫存 as a compact 69x22 outline action, not a filled primary button.
  • Keep broker import menus utility-led at the observed/normative 42px height with dropdown, sync/edit outline actions, and timestamp in one row.
  • Keep #909090 as quiet metadata for broker import timestamps rather than reusing #999999 muted body text.
  • Keep portfolio add-holding actions as orange outline buttons inside a flat #252525 section, not filled CTAs or upload cards.
  • Keep screenshot sync, manual add, and auto sync as one add-action button family with variant-specific icon sizing.
  • Keep 新增持股 follow-up as a compact 375px bottom sheet with 54px rows and one confirm action; do not convert it into a full-page form or card-based wizard.
  • Treat the duplicate-stock red warning as its own add-holding semantic role, not market-up, generic error, or validation banner style.
  • Keep the image-recognition tab content undefined until a selected-state reference is supplied; only the inactive tab label is evidenced.
  • Keep add-holding form body as an internal 375x216 sheet subcomposition rather than a separate page form.
  • Keep add-holding 確定 action scoped to the sheet: disabled is transparent with gray outline/text, enabled/default is orange filled with white label.
  • Keep manual import value fields compact at 70x29, with pale-orange outline reserved for missing required values.
  • Keep manual import rows fixed-column and horizontally table-like with a sticky 136px stock identity column.
  • Keep manual import stock identity cells at 61px row height with compact 18px delete icon, 現股, stock name, and stock code; do not convert them into form cards.
  • Keep relative date labels compact, text-led, and unboxed.
  • Keep event name labels text-only and unboxed.
  • Keep event table row values right-aligned and preserve muted field labels.
  • Keep event filter dropdown trigger separate from the not-yet-observed expanded menu.
  • Keep event filter sheet footer actions, backdrop treatment, and scroll behavior undefined until evidenced.

Source Duplicate Review

No duplicate input source was detected for this pass. S-078 is a standalone switch component set and is distinct from earlier broker import and bottom-sheet rows that only showed a switch slot inside a larger row. S-079 is a standalone checkbox/radio selection-control component set and is distinct from earlier bottom-sheet rows that only showed selection controls inside larger row compositions. S-080 is a centered popup-dialog component frame and is distinct from bottom-sheet sources such as E-067, event-filter sheets, and portfolio add-holding sheets because placement, width, chrome, media ordering, and two-action footer treatment differ. S-081 extends the existing Top App Bar as a stock-title variant rather than a duplicate component. S-082 is an anchored bubble/callout and is distinct from popup dialogs, dropdowns, and profit-chart annotations. S-083 is the global Button primitive and is distinct from sheet-scoped and domain-specific button-like components. S-084 is a grid-style quote tile and is distinct from the full-width Realtime Quote Row and Main Force Stock Row because it owns card/tile geometry and a chart/weather bottom region. S-085 is a full empty-state composition and is distinct from Popup Dialog because it is non-modal, 375x563, centered within a section/page surface, and uses an optional single Button action rather than dialog footer chrome. S-086 is not a duplicate source; it extends the existing Floating Action Pill pattern with an attached black segmented variant rather than replacing the earlier 68x30 orange/warm-gray single-pill sources. S-087 is a standalone compact stock identity label, not a duplicate of row/sheet stock identity because it owns a 28px raised label contract without quote values, sheet columns, valuation semantics, or trade-tag status. S-088 is a standalone stock feed card, not a duplicate of quote rows, quote tiles, event rows, popup dialogs, empty states, bubbles, or broker import rows because it owns author metadata, sentiment tag, View More affordance, and long-form stock commentary. S-089 is a stock return calendar, not a duplicate of Relative Date Label, Event Table Row, Return Today Button, or implementation-derived generic calendar tokens because it owns the full 375px monthly return module, 57x62 trading-day cells, market up/down wash fills, no-market cells, empty cells, month summary row, and weekly summary column. S-090 is a local trend-analysis header/filter composition, not a duplicate of Market Filter Tab Strip, Market Tab Strip, Portfolio Preference Header, Stock Calendar, Event Filter Option, or Button because it owns the 走勢分析 title/actions plus a gray filled range segmented control and separate 自訂 outline action. S-091 is the chart body that follows the trend-analysis header, not a duplicate of S-090, Portfolio Profit Summary, Portfolio Fit Chart, Realtime Quote Tile, or Global Bubble because it owns total-asset/daily-P&L summary metrics, a 343px orange asset area-line series, axis labels, and a selected-date cursor. S-092 is a signed trend-analysis histogram, not a duplicate of S-091, Portfolio Profit Summary, Realtime Quote Tile, Portfolio Fit Chart, or Chart Card because it owns 375x138 geometry, a 37px y-axis label column, 298px plot, red/green bars around zero, and no summary metrics, orange area-line series, selected-date cursor, raised summary, quote identity, or portfolio category rows. S-093 is not a duplicate of S-089; it formalizes the stock-calendar cell component set with selected red/green/zero/no-market borders and a zero-return variant, while the full Stock Calendar remains the composed 375x550 month module. S-094 is a similar-stock result card, not a duplicate of the existing Similar Stock Button, Stock Card, Realtime Quote Row, or Portfolio Fit Stock Sheet because it owns 356x293 comparison-card geometry, similarity score, add-to-watchlist action, and feature-summary panel.

DESIGN_PRINCIPLES.md

Design Principles

PrincipleEvidenceImplementation Rule
Preserve dense operational scanningE-001, E-004, E-005Use compact bars, fixed numeric columns, and flat rows. Do not expand spacing for visual polish unless a future reference shows it.
Keep dark surfaces layered, not decoratedE-001, E-003, E-005, E-007Use #1E1E1E, #252525, #333333, and black as functional depth levels. Avoid gradients, glow effects, and decorative panels.
Keep stock context in the app barE-081, E-003, E-035Use stock-title navigation as a Top App Bar variant with centered stock identity, compact arrows, and 27px action icons. Do not create a separate decorative stock header.
Keep standalone stock identity labels compactE-087, E-005, E-071Use Stock Label only for small display-only stock context markers with code plus name. Do not replace full quote rows, portfolio sheet identity rows, valuation labels, or main-force trade tags with this compact label.
Keep stock feed cards commentary-ledE-088, E-084, E-005Use Stock Card only for stock-specific social/discovery commentary with sentiment, author metadata, and body copy. Do not replace quote rows, quote tiles, event rows, popups, empty states, bubbles, or broker rows with this feed card.
Keep similar-stock results comparison-ledE-094, E-070, E-088, E-005Use Similar Stock Card for compact comparison results with stock quote summary, similarity score, add-to-watchlist action, and feature summaries. Do not replace it with the Similar Stock Button CTA, Stock Card feed/commentary anatomy, quote rows, quote tiles, or portfolio-fit sheet chrome.
Keep return calendars market-ledE-089, E-093, E-006Use Stock Calendar for monthly return scanning with fixed 57x62 Stock Calendar Cells, five trading-day columns, a weekly summary column, red-up/green-down market washes, zero/no-market states, and border-only selected cells. Do not treat calendar red/green as error/success or replace it with event/relative-date components.
Keep trend-analysis filters local and grayE-090, E-046, E-061Use Trend Analysis Header for local chart/analysis period switching with a muted gray filled selected range and separate custom outline action. Do not replace it with market tabs, orange event options, global buttons, or portfolio preference headers.
Keep asset trend charts data-ledE-091, E-090, E-045Use Asset Trend Chart for the chart body beneath trend-analysis controls, preserving the compact total-asset/daily-P&L summary, orange area-line series, muted axes, and selected-date marker. Do not replace it with a raised profit summary card, donut analysis panel, quote mini chart, Global Bubble tooltip, or generic chart card.
Keep signed bar charts baseline-ledE-092, E-091, E-045Use Trend Analysis Bar Chart when a local trend-analysis block needs red/green values above and below a zero baseline. Preserve the 375x138 histogram geometry, 37px y-axis column, 298px plot, 8px square bars, and 46px positive/negative bands. Do not merge it into the orange Asset Trend Chart or the raised Portfolio Profit Summary chart body.
Keep global actions compact and explicitE-083, E-026, E-056, E-069Use the global Button only for app-wide primary fill/outline actions. Preserve explicit pressed and disabled color treatments instead of opacity-only states.
Encode market state with domain colorsE-006Use red for Taiwan stock-up values and green for stock-down values. Do not remap red to error or green to success in market data contexts.
Align numbers for fast comparisonE-005Prices and changes use fixed right-aligned columns. Keep amount, delta, percent, and chart positions stable across rows.
Keep quote tiles grid-specificE-084, E-005, E-074Use Realtime Quote Tile for compact 170x148 watchlist grids with chart/weather bottom content. Do not stretch tiles into list rows or replace Realtime Quote Row with card tiles.
Keep main-force signals row-boundE-075, E-076, E-077In 主力籌碼 views, use one flat 61px row with compact weather, volume, rate, and trade tag slots. Do not promote weather or trade labels into cards, legends, or explanatory modules.
Distinguish analysis categories from market statesE-011, E-012Use portfolio analysis colors only for holding attribute visuals. Do not reuse market up/down tokens for analytics segmentation.
Keep analytics headers compact and actionableE-015, E-016Use a 32px row header with a left accent, inline preference value, and compact right action rather than a large section title.
Keep analytics tables column-stableE-017, E-018Header and rows must share the same column widths so fit, attribute, and value comparisons remain scannable.
Represent portfolio fit as compact sub-status labelsE-030, E-031Use the extracted 68x20 assessment indicator and 105x24 attribute label inside portfolio rows. Do not expand them into standalone cards, legends, or oversized chips.
Explain stock fit in a compact bottom sheetE-032, E-033, E-070, E-071, E-072, E-073Use a 375px bottom sheet with portfolio stock sheet cells, attribute labels, fixed-column scoring details, and one neutral similar-stock action. Do not convert this into a full-screen profile or dashboard panel.
Keep preferred-stock discovery table-ledE-034, E-035, E-036, E-037Use compact title/context bars and a six-column header/row contract. Do not convert preferred-stock discovery into cards, tiles, or marketing-style recommendations.
Treat valuation as its own label languageE-038Use valuation-specific label colors and text. Do not reuse market up/down or portfolio category semantics for price valuation.
Keep stock health checks as diagnostic reportsE-039, E-040, E-041, E-042, E-043, E-044Compose health-check rows from fixed-width cells, then reveal detail sections as flat 375px report blocks. Do not convert diagnostics into cards, progress widgets, dashboards, or explanatory panels.
Keep realtime portfolio P/L compact and expandableE-045Use the three-column profit summary as the stable header and reveal charts below it. Do not replace the module with separate metric cards or oversized dashboard charts.
Separate temporal state from financial stateE-020, E-021Use temporal current/future/past tokens only for calendar labels. Do not map them to market, error, success, or portfolio category semantics.
Keep event labels as metadata, not CTAsE-022, E-023Event-name orange can mark financial calendar metadata without a filled surface, icon, or button treatment. Do not infer interactivity from color alone.
Keep event rows compact but borderedE-024, E-025Event table rows may use a 4px bordered surface when they combine stock identity and multi-line event detail, but should remain narrow, dense, and data-led.
Use compact controls around event listsE-026, E-027Calendar navigation and event filtering controls stay 28px high, outline-based, and label-led. Do not expand them into toolbar cards or oversized filter chips.
Keep event category selection as a bottom sheet gridE-028, E-029Major-event category filters use compact filled options in a 375px bottom sheet. Do not turn them into a full-screen settings page or explanatory filter form.
Keep bottom-sheet chrome modularE-063Use a 64px header for close/back/title variants and a 20px drag-handle strip when the sheet needs grab affordance. Do not rebuild these controls per sheet or add decorative sheet headers.
Keep bottom-sheet rows dense and command-ledE-064, E-065, E-066Use 58-59px full-width rows with 24px/32px utility icons, 18px labels, inset dividers, and compact right-side status/switch slots. Do not convert sheet commands into card rows or large settings panels.
Treat switch as a compact standalone controlE-078, E-064, E-059Use the extracted Switch for binary settings and broker import slots, preserving Android/iOS off/on geometry. Do not replace it with generic checkboxes, text toggles, or row-specific custom artwork.
Treat selection marks as standalone compact controlsE-079, E-067, E-064Use the extracted Selection Control for 20px checkbox/radio slots. Do not replace it with Switch, filled text options, row background changes, or generic browser-default controls.
Keep centered popups distinct from bottom sheetsE-080, E-067, E-029, E-054Use Popup Dialog for compact centered prompts with optional media and two footer actions. Do not reuse 375px bottom-sheet chrome, drag handles, safe-area structure, or sheet footer actions for these 292px dialogs.
Keep empty states section-levelE-085, E-080, E-083Use Empty State for non-modal no-content guidance on a 375px section/page surface. Compose the optional primary action from Button; do not turn Empty State into Popup Dialog, onboarding card, or a new button family.
Keep anchored bubbles directional and compactE-082, E-080, E-027Use Global Bubble for target-attached contextual information with amber fill, dark text, directional arrow, and low shadow. Do not turn bubbles into popups, dropdown menus, or promotional badges.
Keep settings sheets compositionalE-067, E-068, E-069Build inventory settings sheets from Bottom Sheet Header, Bottom Sheet Cell, preview selectors, selection rows, and Bottom Sheet Footer Button where a submit action is required. Do not turn nested settings, sorting, display-mode selection, or watchlist assignment into full-screen pages or card stacks.
Keep portfolio sheet cells domain-specificE-071Use Portfolio Stock Sheet Cell for stock identity, attribute tab summaries, and health-check title summaries inside portfolio bottom sheets. Do not expand generic Bottom Sheet Cell with analytics-specific columns or tab semantics.
Keep market filters compact and text-ledE-046Use a 40px strip with compact filled options; active state changes text color only. Do not inflate secondary market filters into large chips or segmented controls.
Keep inventory primary tabs compactE-060, E-061Use a 37px primary tab strip with white active labels, gray inactive labels, and a chevron only where the source proves expandability. Do not convert primary inventory tabs into underlined web tabs, large chips, or segmented controls.
Persistent controls frame the taskE-001, E-003, E-007, E-008, E-047, E-086Top app bar, bottom navigation, and compact action pills remain anchored around the list or side context. Use the attached 38px black Floating Action Pill group only for watchlist quick actions; avoid page-level hero, card stacks, or dashboard chrome.
Keep add-holding entry points compactE-049, E-050Use orange outline actions inside a flat #252525 section; do not convert add/sync entry points into onboarding cards, upload panels, or large CTAs.
Keep add-holding forms sheet-basedE-054, E-055, E-056Use a compact 375px bottom sheet with 54px form rows, orange outlined controls, segmented stock type, and one 295x41 confirm action that switches from gray outline disabled to orange filled default. Do not convert add-holding into a full-page form, wizard, or card stack.
Keep broker identity container-ledE-048Use compact 46px rounded source containers with short centered labels; do not reinterpret broker source colors as product state or category colors.
Keep promotional badges compact and text-ledE-057, E-059Use 23px yellow gradient badges only for short promo or fee-discount labels. Do not turn them into CTAs, status chips, icons, banners, or glowing marketing tags.
Keep new-state badges separate from promotionsE-065, E-064Use the 42x20 red New badge only as a small status marker on new actions. Do not reuse the yellow Promotional Badge treatment or turn New into a marketing banner.
Keep broker import flows row-ledE-058, E-059, E-048, E-057Use flat 375px import headers and 132px broker rows with broker icon, optional promo badge, helper copy, compact action, and switch slot. Do not convert broker import into account cards, setup panels, or a full-page wizard.
Keep broker import menus utility-ledE-060, E-062Use the 42px broker import menu as a dense utility row with dropdown, sync/edit outline actions, and update metadata. Do not turn it into a toolbar card, banner, or explanatory settings panel.
Keep manual import table-ledE-051, E-052, E-053Use fixed-column 61px rows with compact value fields and a sticky stock identity column. Do not convert manual import into stacked forms or card-based entry.
Labels stay regular-weight and compactE-003, E-005, E-007Use PingFang TC regular, mostly 11-18px. Do not introduce large display type or bold-heavy hierarchy for this screen class.
Data visualizations stay compact and explanatoryE-011, E-013Pair compact visuals with adjacent labels and values. Do not make charts decorative or oversized.

DESIGN_ELEMENTS.md

Design Elements

Color

  • The dominant environment is dark: background #1E1E1E, surface #252525, surface-raised #333333, and scrim black.
  • Primary action is orange #FF7800; secondary/event status is amber #F9A516.
  • Market data uses Taiwan stock semantics: red #EA272D for up, green #39B54A for down.
  • Main-force stock rows use red #EA272D for buy signal values such as 大買 and 3,767, warm #FFD98A for 隔日沖, pink-red #FF8A91 for 短沖, and #C0C0C0 for empty - tags; these are main-force semantics, not generic error/success or portfolio labels.
  • Portfolio analysis uses a separate classification palette: blue #36A9EA for 長期存股, amber #F9A516 for 波段價值, rose #D73152 for 短線價差, and gray #808080 for 無特徵.
  • Portfolio attribute labels use category-color fills for active 亮燈 states, transparent containers with category-color text for inactive 沒燈 states, and gray text for 無特徵.
  • Portfolio fit assessment uses red check/white label for 速配 and green X/gray label for 不速配; these colors communicate fit assessment, not price movement.
  • Portfolio fit stock sheets use the same #252525 surface as the analytics area, a subtle #3D3D3D similar-stock action fill, warm #FFD98A metric values, and red #EA272D high scores.
  • Portfolio stock sheet cells keep portfolio attribute fills blue/amber/rose for active tabs, use muted gray #808080 for inactive tab labels, and use health-check yellow/red values only inside the health-check summary variant.
  • Preferred-stock discovery reuses #252525 section surfaces, #333333 context/header bars, #1E1E1E rows, #C0C0C0 metrics, and orange #FF7800 for accent/action affordances.
  • Valuation labels use a separate palette: orange for 昂貴, peach #FFE2D4 for 合理偏高, pale blue #E5F9FF for 合理偏低, blue #36A9EA for 便宜, and dark gray #252525/gray for 無法評估.
  • Portfolio health-check rows use #1E1E1E cells, normalized #3D3D3D dividers, green #39B54A for 注意 and no-quarter-line X, yellow #FEF769 for note/rank values, red #EA272D for high change values and above-quarter-line check, and orange for report actions.
  • Portfolio health report sections use #252525 surfaces, orange title accents, gray #808080 valuation body copy, muted #999999 labels/descriptions, white values, red #EA272D quality-high states, green #39B54A attention states, #FEF769 detected counts, and pale yellow #FBEEB9 exception titles.
  • Portfolio profit summaries use #252525 raised summary surfaces over #1E1E1E expanded chart bodies; red #EA272D means gain/positive, green #39B54A means loss/negative, empty values are white, and chart grid lines use #3D3D3D.
  • Holding allocation uses a separate chart series palette: #FFA902, #E95B33, #9F5EBB, #3196C1, and #FF3465; do not merge this with the portfolio attribute palette.
  • Temporal date labels use warm pale yellow #FFEEB1 for today and future-relative text, and #C0C0C0 for past-relative text.
  • Event name labels use primary orange #FF7800 as event metadata text, not as a filled action surface.
  • Event table rows use goose yellow #FBEEB9 for stock names, amber #F9A516 for estimated dividend/stock distribution text, and market red/green for change-like values.
  • Compact calendar controls use amber #F9A516 for active outline buttons and gray #808080 for disabled outline buttons.
  • Event filter sheets use #252525 as the sheet surface; filter options use #3D3D3D/#C0C0C0 by default and #FF7800/white when selected.
  • Bottom-sheet headers and cells use #252525 as the shared sheet surface, #C0C0C0 for sheet titles/drag handles, white for utility icons and cell labels, white-8 dividers, #3D3D3D for gray action surfaces, amber #F9A516 and orange #FF7800 for right-side status text, and red #F93951 only for the small New Badge.
  • Switch controls use platform-specific color roles: Android off uses a white 30% track and light neutral knob, Android on uses orange 50% track and orange knob, iOS off uses a dark neutral track with white knob, and iOS on uses an orange track with white knob. The source #BDBDBD knob and #4C4C4C track values are normalized to the existing neutral ramp.
  • Selection controls use gray #999999 outlines for unchecked checkbox/radio states, orange #FF7800 for checked checkbox fill and selected radio outline/mark, and white for the checked checkbox mark.
  • Bottom-sheet composite selectors use #1E1E1E preview option tiles, #3D3D3D preview image borders and scroll thumbs, orange #FF7800 for selected preview outlines, selected check/radio marks, 新增清單, and the 完成 footer action.
  • Bottom Sheet Footer Button uses a #252525 footer strip and a single orange #FF7800 submit action with white label text.
  • Popup Dialog uses the same #252525 core surface as sheets but remains centered; media blocks use #333333, body text uses #D9D9D9, empty-media text uses #808080, primary actions use #FF7800 with white labels, and the observed #414141 secondary/empty artwork strokes are normalized to the existing #3D3D3D control-outline step.
  • Empty State uses #252525 as a full section/page surface, #333333 for optional media placeholders, white for optional titles, #C0C0C0 for body copy, and primary orange only through its optional composed Button action.
  • Global Bubble uses amber #F9A516 with dark #1E1E1E text, keeping callouts bright but compact.
  • Button uses primary orange #FF7800 for default fill/outline, darker orange #CC6102 for pressed fill, deep brown #3F1D00 for pressed outline fill, pale orange #EBC09A for pressed fill labels, and gray #808080 for disabled borders/labels.
  • Stock Label uses #333333 raised fill, white code text, and #C0C0C0 company/security name text; it is identity context, not a valuation or trade-status color language.
  • Stock Card uses #1E1E1E feed surfaces, orange stock code, white stock name/body, #A7A7A7 View More and author metadata, white-20 header divider, neutral sentiment tag #333333/#D9D9D9, bullish sentiment tag rgba(231, 0, 0, 0.2)/#EA272D, and small avatar identity fills #006FFF and #8000FF.
  • Similar Stock Card uses #333333 as the raised result-card root, #252525 as the feature panel, white stock/feature text, #999999 stock code, market red for the observed up price/change, warm #FFD98A for feature section titles, and primary orange for both 加入自選 and the 相似度 chip.
  • Stock Calendar uses #252525 as its module surface, #333333 for empty/no-market cells, normalized #414141 through existing neutral roles for zero cells and weekly summary borders/corners, and translucent red/green market washes for return cells. Stock Calendar Cell selected state is a 1px border: market red/green for red/green cells and white for zero/no-market cells. These red/green fills are market-return semantics, not success/error or validation states.
  • Trend Analysis Header uses #252525 as the local module surface, #333333 as the range group fill, #808080 as the selected range fill plus inactive/custom label and outline color, white for title/share/selected text, and #C0C0C0 for the info icon. This gray selected range state is not a market filter orange state or a disabled state.
  • Asset Trend Chart uses #252525 as the chart body surface, white for the total-asset label/value, #C0C0C0 for the secondary daily-P&L label, red #EA272D for the observed positive daily P&L value, muted #999999 for axis labels and cursor structure, primary orange #FF7800 for the area-line series, and normalized neutral-24 for the selected-date marker fill. This orange chart series is data visualization, not a CTA.
  • Trend Analysis Bar Chart uses #252525 as the local chart surface, subtle chart-grid lines, white y-axis labels, red rgba(234, 39, 45, 0.5) for positive bars above zero, and green rgba(57, 181, 74, 0.5) for negative bars below zero. These red/green fills follow market-style signed-data semantics, not generic error/success or portfolio category colors.
  • Floating Action Pill attached watchlist variants use black #000000 containers, white icons/labels, and a gray #808080 divider; this is an overlay quick-action treatment, not a neutral side-action color.
  • Realtime Quote Tile uses #1E1E1E tile fill, white stock identity, market red/green for price and weather labels, amber event markers, and muted gray #999999 for neutral weather labels.
  • Market filter strips use #333333 for every option item, orange #FF7800 for the active label, and gray #808080 for inactive labels.
  • Primary inventory tab strips use #252525 as the flat strip surface, white for the active tab label, #808080 for inactive labels, orange for the active 看盤/盤後 chevron, gray for its inactive chevron, and white-8 for the bottom divider.
  • Broker/source icons are container-led 46px identities; most labels render white over source-colored rounded containers, while the 我的 holding source uses dark #1E1E1E label text over amber.
  • Promotional badges use a yellow gradient from #FFB800 to #FFE55E, normalized #FFD98A outline, and dark #252525 label text.
  • Broker import headers and rows use the #252525 surface; header labels use white #FFFFFF, helper copy uses dim gray #757575, row dividers use normalized #3D3D3D, and the compact 查看庫存 outline combines primary orange text with a deeper orange #B95700 stroke.
  • Broker import menus use #1E1E1E background, a deeper orange #B95700 dropdown outline, primary orange for sync/edit outlines/icons/labels, white dropdown text, and #909090 for last-update metadata.
  • Portfolio add-holding actions use orange #FF7800 for outline, label, and icon on a flat #252525 section surface.
  • Portfolio add holding sheets use #252525 for the sheet, header, warning block, and rows; orange for outlines, selected stock type, active tab underline, and enabled confirm fill; white for enabled confirm label; #808080 for disabled confirm and cost placeholder; #C0C0C0 for inactive tab labels; and #FF4F4F only for duplicate-stock warning copy.
  • Portfolio manual import rows use #252525 cells, #333333 header/value-field fills, white-8 dividers, pale orange #FFD7B2 for missing required value outlines, gray #999999 for placeholder text, white for entered/dash values, and amber #F9A516 for the 現股 stock type label.
  • Muted text uses #999999 and inactive navigation uses #808080.
  • Row dividers on #1E1E1E use #4B4B4B.

Typography

  • Typeface: PingFang TC regular.
  • Quote names: 18px / 24px.
  • Stock codes: 14px / 20px.
  • Price values: 18px / 24px.
  • Change values: 16px / 22px.
  • Main-force weather labels use 22px regular text; main-force row volumes use 18px / 24px, rates use 14px / 20px, and trade tags use 14px compact labels.
  • Bottom navigation labels: 15px / 16px.
  • Event metadata: 11px, normal line height.
  • Portfolio fit score: 22px / 26px with 12px label and percent unit.
  • Portfolio analysis rows: 13px / 18px.
  • Portfolio preference header labels: 14px compact line height.
  • Portfolio fit list headers: 12px / 18px muted labels.
  • Portfolio fit stock row names: 18px / 24px; codes: 14px / 20px; percentage value: 16px / 24px; market value: 14px / 20px.
  • Portfolio attribute labels use 14px medium compact text.
  • Portfolio fit assessment indicators use 14px compact labels.
  • Portfolio fit stock sheets use 20px stock names, 18px stock codes, 14px table headers, and 18px detail values.
  • Portfolio stock sheet cells use 20px identity stock names, 18px identity stock codes, 14px medium attribute labels, 12px health-check headers, 18px health stock names, 14px health stock codes, and 16px health values.
  • Preferred-stock title uses 16px title text and 14px update text.
  • Preferred-stock context top bar uses a 16px medium attribute tag and 18px title text.
  • Preferred-stock list headers use 12px / 18px muted labels; rows use 18px / 24px metrics and 14px / 20px stock codes.
  • Valuation labels use 14px medium centered text.
  • Portfolio health-check stock cells use 18px stock names and 14px codes; diagnostic cells use 16px compact text; report action uses 12px text.
  • Portfolio health report sections use 18px titles/summaries, 16px body and metric text, and 14px exception descriptions.
  • Portfolio profit summaries use 16px muted PingFang labels, 22px SF Pro Text numeric values, 14px rates, 12px cost metadata, 10px chart axis labels, and 13px allocation legend rows.
  • Relative date labels use 18px date text and 16px relative-day text with normal line height.
  • Event name labels use 16px PingFang TC regular with normal line height.
  • Event table rows use 16px stock names, 13px stock codes, 15px event details, and 11px compact stock code text only for overflow cases.
  • Return-today buttons and event filter dropdowns use 14px compact labels; return-today uses PingFang TC medium, dropdown labels use regular.
  • Event filter sheet titles use 18px centered text; event filter options use 16px centered labels.
  • Bottom-sheet headers use 18px centered title text; bottom-sheet cells use 18px regular labels and status text.
  • Bottom-sheet preview option labels use 15px regular centered text; 新增清單 uses 16px regular orange text; 完成 uses 18px medium white text.
  • Popup Dialog titles use compact centered 16px medium text, body copy uses 14px regular text, and footer action labels use 14px medium text.
  • Empty State uses centered 18px regular title text and 16px regular body copy, both with normal line height and a low text shadow. The optional action uses the existing Button label typography.
  • Global Bubble uses 16px medium title text and 14px medium body text.
  • Button labels are medium weight and scale with size: 14px for tiny/small, 16px for medium, 18px for large, and 20px for giant.
  • Floating Action Pill labels use 14px PingFang TC medium with 22px line height in both 68x30 single pills and 38px attached variants.
  • Stock-title Top App Bar uses 17px title text by default, 13px for extreme long titles, 14px stock code text, and 12px previous/next arrows.
  • Realtime Quote Tile uses 18px stock name, 16px stock code, 28px price text with 34px line height, 14px change text, 11px event/weather labels, and 40px 大買 signal text in the one-day after-hours variant.
  • Stock Label uses 14px PingFang TC medium text for both code and name in one compact line.
  • Stock Card uses 16px medium stock header text, 14px regular View More/sentiment/metadata text with medium author names, 10px semibold avatar initials, and 16px regular body copy at a normalized 22px line height.
  • Similar Stock Card uses 18px regular stock name text, 14px stock code/action/change/similarity text, 18px medium price text, and 13px feature title/body text. Feature titles are medium and warm; feature body copy remains regular white text.
  • Stock Calendar uses PingFang TC for title, month selector, summary, and column labels, while daily/weekly numeric cell content uses Roboto 12px with compact 14px line height. Stock Calendar Cell confirms regular day/rate text in default cells, semibold amount values, and bold emphasis only for selected zero day/rate text.
  • Trend Analysis Header uses 18px semibold PingFang TC for 走勢分析, 13px medium text for the selected range label, and 14px regular text for inactive range labels and the 自訂 action.
  • Asset Trend Chart uses PingFang TC regular for 16px 總資產, 14px 當日損益, and 12px axis/date labels, with 18px medium summary values. Axis and date-marker labels use a compact 12px/16px treatment rather than the smaller 10px portfolio-profit chart axis style.
  • Trend Analysis Bar Chart uses Roboto regular 12px y-axis labels with a 16px line-height for compact numeric K-unit values such as 30.6K, 0K, and -45.3K.
  • Similar Stock Button uses 18px regular white label text next to a search icon.
  • New Badge uses white Play Bold 14px text, not PingFang TC.
  • Market filter strip labels use 14px PingFang TC regular with normal compact line height.
  • Primary inventory tab labels use 16px PingFang TC regular with normal line height.
  • Broker/source icon labels use normalized 16px PingFang TC semibold with normal line height; the source observed 16.1px is treated as a Figma export artifact.
  • Promotional badge labels use 12px text; the default import promo is medium, while fee/VIP emphasis labels use semibold.
  • Broker import headers use 16px regular labels; broker import rows use 18px regular titles, 16px helper copy, and compact action labels normalized from observed 14.063px to 14px.
  • Broker import menus use 16px regular dropdown labels, 13px sync/edit action labels, and 12px / 14px timestamp metadata.
  • Portfolio add action labels use 16px PingFang TC medium with normal line height.
  • Portfolio add holding sheets use 18px title/tab/action labels, 16px field labels and control text, 15px duplicate warning text, and 22px quantity stepper symbols.

Shape

  • Segmented selector corners: 2px.
  • Edge toggle corners: 4px on exposed side.
  • Event table rows use 4px radius and a 1px #3D3D3D border.
  • Event filter dropdowns use 5px radius and a 1px #3D3D3D border.
  • Event filter sheets use 12px top corners; event filter options use 4px corners.
  • Bottom-sheet headers use 12px top corners; drag handles use a full pill radius.
  • Bottom-sheet gray action surfaces and boxed 彈 utility icon use 4px corners.
  • Switch tracks and knobs use full-radius pill/circle geometry; do not square the track or add rectangular outlines.
  • Selection Control checkboxes use 2px corners; Selection Control radios use full-circle geometry. Do not round checkbox variants into pills or square radio variants.
  • Bottom-sheet preview option tiles use 8px corners; preview thumbnails use 2px corners; footer actions use 4px corners.
  • Similar Stock Button and Bottom Sheet Footer Button actions both use 4px corners while preserving different fills and intent.
  • Similar Stock Card uses 4px corners for the root, feature panel, and similarity chip; do not turn the feature panel into nested cards.
  • Popup Dialog containers and footer actions use 4px corners; do not apply bottom-sheet top-only 12px/16px radii.
  • Empty State itself has no card radius; only the optional media placeholder is a square dark block and the optional CTA inherits Button's 4px radius.
  • Global Bubble uses 8px corners and a triangular arrow; do not round it into a pill or square it into a dropdown.
  • Button uses 4px corners across fill, outline, disabled, and icon-only variants.
  • Realtime Quote Tile uses 4px corners and remains a compact dark tile, not a card stack with large radii.
  • Main-force trade tags use 4px corners with a 1px outline for 隔日沖 and 短沖; the empty dash variant has no visible outline.
  • New Badge uses a full capsule radius.
  • Market filter strip option items use 4px corners.
  • Primary inventory tab strips remain square-edged; no active underline, active pill, or rounded tab item is observed.
  • Broker import menu dropdown and action controls use 4px corners with a 1px outline.
  • Promotional badges use 8px corners with a 1px outline.
  • Broker import row inline actions use 4px corners with a 1px outline.
  • Portfolio add action buttons use 8px corners with a 1px orange outline.
  • Portfolio add holding sheets use 8px top corners for default/duplicate headers, 12px top corners for the tabbed header, and 4px corners for outlined controls.
  • Portfolio manual import value fields use 4px corners; row and header cells remain square-edged.
  • Portfolio analysis detail panel corners: 8px.
  • Portfolio preference header action corners: 4px.
  • Portfolio attribute labels use a 14px pill radius.
  • Portfolio fit assessment indicators use a 4px radius transparent frame.
  • Portfolio fit stock sheets use 16px top corners; the similar-stock action uses a 4px radius.
  • Valuation labels use 14px pill radius.
  • Stock Labels use 4px corners and no border; do not round them into valuation/tag pills.
  • Stock Cards keep square outer edges; sentiment tags use 4px corners and avatars are circular.
  • Asset Trend Chart has no outer card radius. Only the selected-date marker uses the compact 4px radius; do not replace it with a rounded bubble or large tooltip.
  • Trend Analysis Bar Chart has no outer card radius, no rounded plot panel, and square-edged bars. Do not round the bars or add card chrome around the histogram.
  • Stock Calendar day, zero, no-market, empty, and weekly summary cells use 8px corners; weekly summary corner badges also use 8px corners. Empty cells are outline-only rather than filled cards, and selected Stock Calendar Cells keep the same 8px radius with a 1px outline.

  • Home indicator: 100px radius.
  • Quote rows and bars remain square-edged.

Elevation And Depth

  • Depth is represented by surface color changes, not shadows.
  • Shadows are rare; profit summary surfaces use a 0/4/10 black alpha shadow, while most other surfaces remain flat.
  • Switch knobs use tight platform shadows only: Android has a low 0/1/1 plus 0/0/1 shadow stack, while iOS has a stronger 0/2/2 shadow.
  • Global Bubble is one of the few non-row components with elevation, using a low 0/2/4 black alpha-12 shadow normalized from the 3.5px Figma blur.
  • Empty State uses a low 0/4/4 black alpha-25 text shadow on title/body copy, but does not add card elevation or container shadows.
  • Stock Calendar uses a compact green-tinted text shadow on numeric cell text only. Do not apply that shadow to the module container, title, or other calendar-like components.
  • Attached watchlist Floating Action Pill variants use a low 0/4/2 black alpha-25 overlay shadow; earlier 68x30 side-action pills remain flat.
  • Active bottom navigation uses a darker/raised fill region rather than outline or shadow.
  • Portfolio health-check stock cells may use a 4px x-offset shadow to indicate a sticky first column in a horizontally scrolling row.
  • Portfolio manual import stock identity cells use a 4px x-offset sticky-edge shadow; the stronger 4/0/5 shadow appears on the row stock cell.

Data Display

  • Quote rows allocate fixed widths for price and change columns.
  • Realtime Quote Tile presents the same quote semantics in a compact grid tile: stable stock identity, price/change row, and bottom chart/event or weather region inside a 170x148 frame.
  • Stock Card presents stock-specific feed commentary with sentiment, author avatar, author/time metadata, and body copy. It is not a quote row/tile because it has no price, delta, chart, or market-data columns.
  • Stock Calendar presents monthly return data as a market-return grid with five trading-day columns, one weekly summary column, no-market cells, empty outside-month cells, and signed amount/rate values. It is not an event calendar, date picker, or generic heatmap dashboard.
  • Inline sparkline area is 76x36.
  • Main-force stock rows use fixed weather, value, and trade-tag columns rather than quote price/change/chart columns.
  • Main-force weather can be one-day text plus icon or a three-day icon sequence; do not expand it into a separate chart.
  • Main-force trade tags are row metadata, not filters or promotional badges.
  • Portfolio fit chart uses a 117px donut area beside a 234px rounded detail panel.
  • Analysis bars use fixed 18px height and 128px maximum width.
  • Portfolio preference header uses a 3x14 orange accent and a 12px chevron icon.
  • Portfolio fit rows use a 68x20 assessment indicator and a 105x24 attribute label aligned under the list header columns.
  • Portfolio attribute labels combine category and percentage inside the attribute column; no-feature state omits the percentage.
  • Portfolio fit assessment indicators pair a 14px status icon with text; the icon is not a substitute for the label.
  • Portfolio fit stock sheets explain a row through a compact bottom sheet: portfolio stock sheet cells, attribute labels, fixed-column detail table, and one neutral similar-stock action.
  • Portfolio stock sheet cells separate identity, attribute-tab summaries, and health-check title summaries from generic settings cells.
  • Portfolio fit detail tables keep item labels left-aligned while individual performance and score values are right-aligned; info rows can leave the performance column empty while retaining the score column.
  • Preferred-stock lists use a six-column table for stock identity, dividend years, yield, volatility, feature percentage, and add-to-watchlist action.
  • Preferred-stock rows use a 22px add-stock icon inside a 27px action column.
  • Valuation labels are compact standalone assessment markers, not primary actions.
  • Portfolio health-check rows use a diagnostic table composition with sticky stock identity, report action, valuation, attention text, numeric metrics, trend graphic, and quarter-line status.
  • Portfolio health report sections extend the row diagnostics into flat detail blocks: valuation paragraph, quality metric list, and exception list.
  • Portfolio profit summaries use a stable three-column metric header and optional below-summary charts for daily P/L bars, cumulative gain/loss split, or holding allocation donut.
  • Quarter-line status icons pair domain state with icon shape; red check means above the quarterly line, green X means not above it.
  • Relative date labels use fixed content widths from 76px to 137px depending on date and relative text length.
  • Event name labels are text-only; no event-name icon, badge fill, or divider is shown in the extracted component set.
  • Event table rows put stock identity on the left and event details right-aligned on the right; detail blocks may use one, two, or four lines.
  • Event filter dropdowns reserve 64px for the label so 全部, 2項事件, and 11項事件 align consistently.
  • Event filter sheets present event categories as a compact 3-column selection grid rather than as a long form.
  • Bottom-sheet headers separate sheet chrome from sheet body content; close/back/title/drag affordances should be composed from the header variants instead of recreated per sheet.
  • Bottom-sheet cells present commands and settings as dense rows with leading utility icon, label, optional status text, optional switch slot, or a gray action surface.
  • Bottom-sheet composites present nested settings as compact sheets: top-level settings rows can navigate to preview selectors or sort selectors, while watchlist assignment uses a scrollable multi-select list plus one 完成 action.
  • Display-mode previews are functional state previews and should remain small thumbnails inside selector options.
  • Popup Dialog presents prompt content as a centered media/text/action composition; it is not a bottom sheet, card grid, or page-level empty state.
  • New Badge marks action novelty only; it is not promotional copy or a primary action.
  • Market filter strips present secondary quote views as compact text options, with selection indicated by label color instead of a changed item fill.
  • Primary inventory tab strips present major holdings sections as compact tabs, with active state indicated by label color and the 看盤/盤後 chevron color.
  • Broker/source icon sets present source identity only; they do not define selection, connection, or account-status state by themselves.
  • Promotional badges present short promo or fee-discount metadata and can be composed inline with a row title.
  • Broker import rows combine source identity, import capability copy, promo metadata, inventory access, and a switch slot in one flat list row.
  • Broker import menus combine broker filtering, sync/edit commands, and last-update metadata in one 42px row rather than a separate toolbar or card.
  • Portfolio add action sections present add/sync entry points as compact outline actions, not as onboarding cards or upload panels.
  • Portfolio add holding sheets present one compact form: stock select, stock type segmented control, total shares stepper, cost average field, unit labels, optional duplicate warning, and one confirm action that can be disabled gray outline or enabled orange fill.
  • Portfolio manual import rows are fixed-column, horizontally table-like rows. Missing required values use compact 請填寫 fields, entered values use formatted numbers, and intentionally empty values use -.
  • Market movement triangle and candlestick marker follow market color.
  • Event metadata sits below stock identity, not in a separate card.

State Language

  • Selection is conveyed through filled neutral surfaces.
  • Primary action is orange; neutral action is warm gray.
  • Inactive navigation is gray text/icon on black.
  • Disabled behavior exists in prior color tokens but was not visible in this Figma node.
  • Temporal colors communicate calendar relationship only; do not reuse them for market, error, or portfolio category state.
  • Event orange communicates financial event metadata in this component; do not infer it as a tappable primary action without interaction evidence.
  • Event table rows are informational rows by default; bordered surface treatment does not imply card-stack marketing layout.
  • Return-today disabled state is observed as gray border and label, not opacity.
  • Event filter dropdown open menu and selected option treatments are not yet defined.
  • Event filter option selected state is a filled orange surface; default state is a filled neutral surface, not an outline.
  • Bottom-sheet cell status uses right-side text/chevron or a switch slot; do not infer row pressed/selected state from the default surface.
  • Bottom-sheet preview selection uses an orange outline around the selected preview tile; sort selection uses an orange check icon; watchlist selection uses orange selected radio/check control and white unselected radio outline.
  • Bottom Sheet Footer Button is a submit-only bottom-sheet action; disabled, loading, destructive, and dual-action footer states are not yet evidenced.
  • Popup Dialog observed actions are default-only: left secondary outline and right orange primary. Pressed, focus-visible, disabled, loading, destructive, close-dismiss, and single-action states are not yet evidenced.
  • New Badge state is default-only; dismissed, disabled, pressed, localized, and long-label states are not yet evidenced.
  • MyStock utility icons are default white assets; selected, disabled, or status-color variants are not yet evidenced.
  • Market filter selected state is orange label text on the same dark item fill; do not swap to an orange filled item without evidence.
  • Primary inventory tab selected state is white label text on the same dark strip; inactive tabs use gray text, and only 看盤/盤後 exposes a chevron color state.
  • Broker/source icon state is not evidenced beyond default identity artwork; do not infer selected, connected, or unavailable treatments from the icon set alone.
  • Promotional badges are informational in the observed nodes; do not infer pressed, selected, dismissible, or disabled states.
  • Broker import row observed state is imported/on with an inline action; row-specific switch disabled/loading/error, row pressed, and no-promo states are not yet evidenced. Standalone Switch supplies off/on visuals.
  • Broker import menu observed state is the default all-broker row with 同步 and 編輯 available; dropdown expanded, selected broker, disabled, syncing, edit-mode, error, and timestamp-absent states are not yet evidenced.
  • Portfolio add action buttons are orange outline actions by default; pressed, focus-visible, disabled, permission, sync-progress, and error states are not yet evidenced.
  • Portfolio add holding sheets show disabled confirm as explicit gray outline/text, enabled confirm as orange fill with white text, duplicate-stock warning as red text in the sheet flow, selected stock type as orange fill, and active manual tab as an orange underline; selected-stock, image-recognition content, keyboard, pressed, loading, save-success, and network-error states are not yet evidenced.
  • Portfolio manual import missing required state is the pale-orange outlined 請填寫 value field; it is not a focused state, validation banner, or generic error state without future evidence.
  • Portfolio attribute active state is filled; inactive state is transparent but keeps the category color on the label and white on the percent.
  • Portfolio stock sheet attribute tabs differ from standalone attribute labels: inactive tab labels are muted gray, while active tab labels are filled with the category color and white text.
  • Portfolio fit assessment match/mismatch states must stay semantic to fit evaluation, not generic success/error or market movement.
  • Portfolio fit stock sheet open state is a bottom sheet surface, not a page transition; backdrop, close, drag, scroll, and transition behaviors are not yet evidenced.
  • Similar Stock Button is neutral navigation, not a primary submit action; pressed, focus-visible, disabled, and loading states are not yet evidenced.
  • Portfolio fit high-score red is a scoring signal in this sheet, not a market-up value.
  • Portfolio fit detail table info rows use the 14px info icon as a tooltip affordance only; the icon does not change row selection or score state by itself.
  • Preferred-stock add icon is an action affordance, but selected/added state is not yet evidenced.
  • Valuation label variants are semantic assessment states; 無法評估 is unavailable valuation, not a disabled interaction state.
  • Health-check report action is an inline row action; health-check cell selected/pressed/loading states are not yet evidenced.
  • Health report detail sections are informational by default; empty, loading, collapsed, no-exception, pressed, and focus states are not yet evidenced.
  • Profit summary expand/collapse is indicated by compact chart toggles; pressed/focus-visible, loading, error, hidden-cost, and chart tooltip states are not yet evidenced.
  • Quarter-line status colors are technical-condition semantics, not generic validation semantics.
  • Stock Card sentiment states are feed/commentary states, not market price movement, filter selection, or valuation assessment. The observed type=defualt neutral and type=bullish variants do not define pressed, selected, bookmarked, loading, collapsed, expanded, or bearish behavior.
  • Stock Calendar cell fills are market-return states: red translucent means positive/up return, green translucent means negative/down return, #333333 fill means no-market, outline-only means empty outside-month, and stronger red means highlighted/high-intensity up in the observed source. It does not define selected/focused/pressed calendar interaction states.

Prefix

All project tokens use the --cm-* prefix.

Layers

  • tokens/tokens-ref.css: raw values only. Names describe hue, dark-to-light palette step, neutral step, raw size, radius, typeface, weight, opacity, or line-height value.
  • tokens/tokens-sys.css: product-wide semantic roles. These tokens reference --cm-ref-* only.
  • tokens/tokens-comp.css: component slot roles. These tokens reference --cm-sys-* only.
  • tokens/tokens.css: import entry point in ref -> sys -> comp order.

Naming Decisions

  • The exported Chinese style names are treated as source labels, not final token names.
  • Reference color numbers use dark-to-light ordering: smaller steps are darker and larger steps are lighter. *-alpha-* tokens are the exception; their trailing number describes opacity.
  • Orange is primary; amber is secondary and event-badge color.
  • #1E1E1E, #252525, #333333, and #000000 form the dark app shell.
  • Taiwan stock-market semantics are preserved: red is market-up, green is market-down.
  • Main-force buy/weather signals receive main-force-* semantic roles even when they reuse red, so they are not confused with market-up price movement or generic error.
  • #FFD98A and #FF8A91 are modeled as main-force trade-tag roles for 隔日沖 and 短沖; they are not promotional badges, portfolio attributes, or validation states.
  • #7E7873 is modeled as selected control and neutral floating action color.
  • #36A9EA, #F9A516, #D73152, and #808080 are modeled as portfolio analysis category colors, not market state colors.
  • #EA272D and #39B54A are reused by 速配評估, but system tokens name them as fit-assessment match and mismatch roles so the slot is not mistaken for price movement or generic success/error.
  • #EA272D is also used as a portfolio fit score color in the stock sheet; it receives a score-specific system role instead of reusing market-up.
  • The observed #404040 subtle action surface is normalized to #3D3D3D / --cm-ref-color-neutral-24 so it shares the neutral control step with compact outlines and event filter options.
  • #FFE2D4 and #E5F9FF are raw valuation label hues; system tokens name them as valuation states rather than market or portfolio category colors.
  • The 偏好股票 six-column list gets separate system size roles so it does not mutate the earlier portfolio fit list columns.
  • #FEF769 is modeled as a portfolio health-check note color, separate from temporal yellow.
  • The observed #424242 and #434343 divider values are normalized to #3D3D3D / --cm-ref-color-neutral-24 so outline and neutral control steps do not carry duplicate near-identical ref values.
  • The health-check stock cell shadow is tokenized separately and is not a general elevation pattern.
  • #FFEEB1 is modeled as temporal current/future text, not a warning or portfolio category color.
  • #FF7800 can also be modeled as event-name text when used for financial event metadata, separate from filled primary actions.
  • #FBEEB9 is modeled as event table stock-name text and health report exception-title text through separate system roles, both separate from temporal yellow and warm highlight text.
  • #3D3D3D now covers chart-grid structure, compact control outlines, and neutral action surfaces through separate system roles.
  • #FFA902, #E95B33, #9F5EBB, #3196C1, and #FF3465 are allocation chart series colors, not portfolio attribute category colors.
  • Profit/loss gains reuse market-up red and losses reuse market-down green because the reference follows Taiwan stock color convention.
  • #F9A516 is used for both secondary brand color and compact return-today outline controls; component tokens preserve the slot distinction.
  • #3D3D3D is reused for neutral event filter options and compact control outlines; component tokens preserve each slot's intent.
  • Secondary market filter active state uses primary orange text only; the system size tokens use market-filter rather than a component-specific tab name.
  • Primary inventory tabs are tokenized separately from secondary market filters because their active state is white label text on a 37px flat strip instead of orange text inside filled option items.
  • System size tokens for primary inventory tabs use market-primary instead of tab so component vocabulary stays in the component token layer.
  • #7E7873 is reused for neutral side action pills in addition to floating quote actions, so the existing action-neutral role remains the correct system token.
  • 51034:5228 extends Floating Action Pill rather than creating a new button component: the attached watchlist group shares floating quick-action purpose and icon-label anatomy, while adding black overlay grouping, a divider, and a low shadow.
  • The black attached Floating Action Pill container maps to the existing scrim/black system role; it is not a new neutral action color and should not replace the warm-gray neutral side-action pill treatment.
  • Broker/source icon labels receive component-specific color slots because the logo artwork determines whether white or dark label text is required.
  • Promo badge yellow values are modeled as promo-specific system roles, not as warning, event, temporal, or generic highlight colors. The observed #FFDA8C promo border is normalized to the existing warm highlight ref #FFD98A.
  • #252525 can be both product surface and promo badge label color; the component token keeps the on-promo slot distinct from dark-surface body copy.
  • #EBEBF5 is modeled as on-surface-secondary for secondary bottom-sheet chrome, separate from strong white body copy, and named as a primitive lavender step in the ref layer.
  • #F93951 is modeled as status-new, separate from warning, market-up, duplicate-warning, error, and promotional badge roles.
  • The red New Badge is a separate component from Promotional Badge because it uses a flat red pill, Play Bold text, and a compact 42x20 asset slot instead of yellow promo artwork.
  • Bottom Sheet Header and Bottom Sheet Cell are extracted as reusable sheet chrome/body rows for existing sheet-specific components such as event filter, add holding, and fit stock sheets.
  • Bottom Sheet Cell action rows reuse the normalized #3D3D3D action-subtle surface; this extends the earlier similar-stock neutral action role without turning it into a generic card background.
  • Switch is a standalone component after 8134:289037: Android and iOS variants own off/on track, knob, opacity, and shadow tokens. Bottom Sheet Cell and Broker Import Row now compose Switch in their right-side switch slots.
  • Selection Control is a standalone component after 22911:207990: checkbox and radio variants own 20px frame, gray outline, orange selected states, white checkbox mark, and orange radio mark tokens. Bottom Sheet Cell and Bottom Sheet selection rows compose Selection Control in row slots instead of owning checkbox/radio artwork.
  • Popup Dialog is a standalone centered dialog component after 5906:218640: it owns the 292px width, #252525 surface, media/empty-state roles, title/body typography, and two-action footer. It is not a bottom-sheet variant and should not reuse Bottom Sheet Footer Button tokens.

Sheet-scoped and domain-scoped actions retain their component-specific tokens until an implementation explicitly composes the primitive.

It is not a Relative Date Label, Event Table Row, Return Today Button, or generic date-picker/calendar-grid variant.

  • Stock Calendar Cell selected state is border-only. Red/green selected cells keep the same 30% market wash and add a market-color border; zero/no-market selected cells add a white border. The red 50% day from the full Stock Calendar remains a highlighted/high-intensity state, not selected.

It is not a Market Filter Tab Strip, Market Tab Strip, Portfolio Preference Header, Stock Calendar, Event Filter Option, or Button variant.

  • The observed Trend Analysis Header selected-option shadow 0 2px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15) is normalized to the existing low surface shadow role because the visual difference from 0 2px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12) is not meaningful enough to add another shadow primitive.

  • Portfolio Fit Detail Table receives explicit header and component-set size tokens from 29209:162952 and 29209:163029, while retaining the earlier 171/100/64 column contract from the full stock sheet.
  • MyStock Utility Icon is asset-led; tokens define size, color, and the boxed bounce glyph treatment, but do not infer selection, disabled, or brand-color states.
  • Broker import row helper copy uses a dim text role for #757575, which is lower emphasis than the existing muted #999999.
  • Broker import row 查看庫存 uses primary orange for text but a deeper outline stroke, so the stroke receives a separate action-outline role rather than reusing the primary outline.
  • Broker import rows keep the same slot placement, but the visual control should be supplied by the standalone Switch component when the row needs a rendered switch.
  • Broker import menu dropdown/action controls are tokenized as a 42px utility row, separate from Broker Import Header and Broker Import Row because the node's Figma description explicitly calls 42px the future unified height.
  • #909090 is modeled as a quiet on-surface metadata role for broker import menu timestamps rather than overloading the existing muted #999999 or subtle #808080 roles.
  • Broker import menu action icons and labels reuse primary orange, but component tokens keep sync/edit slots separate from Portfolio Add Action Button and Broker Import Row action slots.
  • Portfolio add actions reuse primary orange for outline, label, and icon, but component tokens keep the add/sync slot separate from filled primary actions.
  • Portfolio add holding sheets reuse surface, primary orange, disabled gray, and strong text roles, while #FF4F4F receives a separate duplicate-warning role instead of becoming a market, success/error, or validation token. Filled disabled buttons use the separate disabled-container / on-disabled-container pair so label and container do not resolve to the same gray.
  • Add holding sheet system tokens avoid component anatomy terms such as input, button, and tab; those names appear only in component tokens where slots need to describe the sheet structure.
  • The inactive image-recognition tab is tokenized as a label/indicator state only; the selected image-recognition panel is not tokenized because its content is not visible in this reference.
  • The add holding confirm action remains scoped under sheet action tokens. The generic Figma node name button is not promoted to a global button component because only this sheet context and 確定 label are evidenced.
  • Manual import value fields reuse existing dark surface and pale-orange primary-container roles; component tokens distinguish missing required, entered, and empty value slots.
  • Manual import rows reuse sticky-edge shadow semantics with a stronger observed shadow step for the stock identity column.
  • Manual import system token names avoid input and field; those terms appear only in component tokens where component anatomy is allowed.
  • The 7px icon/label gap is modeled as a reusable compact icon-label spacing role because both the add action section and button content depend on it.
  • Divider colors are normalized into outline-* contrast steps rather than named after their original background hex values.
  • Component tokens are only created for observed slots in the inspected Figma nodes: button, empty-state, stock-label, stock-card, stock-calendar, stock-calendar-cell, trend-analysis-header, asset-trend-chart, trend-analysis-bar-chart, top app bar, bottom navigation, bottom sheet, bottom sheet footer button, bottom sheet header, bottom sheet cell, switch, selection control, global bubble, realtime quote row, realtime quote tile, main force stock row, main force weather indicator, main force trade tag, portfolio preference header, portfolio fit chart, portfolio fit list header, portfolio fit stock row, portfolio attribute label, portfolio fit assessment indicator, portfolio stock sheet cell, portfolio fit stock sheet, portfolio fit detail table, similar stock button, portfolio preferred stock title, portfolio preferred stock top bar, portfolio preferred stock list header, portfolio preferred stock row, valuation label, quarter line status icon, portfolio health check cell, portfolio health check row, portfolio health report section, portfolio profit summary, MyStock utility icon, New Badge, broker icon, promotional badge, broker import header, broker import row, broker import menu, portfolio add action button, portfolio add action section, portfolio add holding sheet, portfolio manual import value field, portfolio manual import cell, portfolio manual import row, market tab strip, market filter tab strip, relative date label, event name label, event table row, return today button, event filter dropdown, event filter option, event filter sheet, floating action pill, and edge status toggle.

Inheritance Rule

component token -> system token -> reference token -> raw value

Do not skip a layer. Add a reusable system role before adding a component slot when a component needs a new semantic value.
